annotations.title: Replay a Forge Orbital decision from its inputs

description: Replays a Forge Orbital demo decision: re-runs the deterministic engine on the same sample scenario (and any withdrawn evidence) and checks that the replay key and the decision match the record. Replayability is the point: the same inputs and engine version give the same decision. Reads nothing about the user. Demo only, fictional sample data.

record.description: The complete signed record object returned inside run_check, unchanged, including its signature and original decision fields. Pass the record object, not the outer tool response, a record ID, a summary or a JSON string. Deliberate edits are useful only when demonstrating failed verification.
record.title: Record

scenario_id.description: One fictional sample scenario ID returned by list_scenarios. Use vendor_payment for the guided payment example. This is not a user account or live workflow ID.
scenario_id.title: Scenario Id

withdraw_evidence.description: Optional evidence IDs to remove from this sample decision. Use only evidence IDs listed for the selected scenario by list_scenarios; omit, null or [] keeps all evidence. For replay, use exactly the same withdrawals as the original run_check.
withdraw_evidence.title: Withdraw Evidence
